selection.eligibility: All24 unique development cases completed with the guarded native oracle and independent successful-patch review. Partial arms, prototypes, raw pre-guard false greens and holdout outcomes cannot select the recipe.
ranking: Most verified publications among the24 development cases under each completed cohort's ORIGINAL frozen guarded native oracle. Report confirmed semantic false greens separately; never rewrite prior native scores.

Lowest measured total trial latency over all24 trials, then stable lexicographic arm ID only on an exact final tie. Latency remains descriptive and confounded by native compilation, scheduling and cache state.

confirmation.other_settings: Port the selected completed guarded development RECIPE PARAMETERS onto the safer current V6 graph. The fresh24 trials verify the upgraded path before final freeze. Corpus mutations/splits remain unchanged.

holdout_after_confirmation.prerequisite: Freeze the exact selected V6 implementation and recipe after development confirmation, with all failed/partial trials retained.

baseline_recipe.native_guard_rules: Same current V6 evidence-validity, stability and trusted native oracle rules as the selected winner.

mechanical_controls: Two baseline checks reject unchanged native FAIL/PASS before a scripted proposal is invoked.
Malformed additional native baseline evidence blocks a matching primary failure before a scripted proposal is invoked.
Stable repeated native failures plus a real source repair still reach a tested local bare-Git/PR receipt.
Explicit default1 compatibility control retains the original single-baseline flake risk; it is not live Luna evidence.
metrics: Guarded native completion and first-repair completion on unique cases.
Actual Luna calls by kind, tokens, wall time and failure stage, separating baseline evidence/stability safe stops from model failures.
Requested/observed baseline repetitions, complete original executed-test retention and exact candidate/pushed/PR heads.
Wilson95 interval by unique case using the first listed completed trial; all repeated holdout trials remain separate outcomes.
claim_limits: Finite repeated observations reduce exposure to flaky failures; they do not prove a test is deterministic or prove causal correctness of every fix.
